How did each game look in outcomes and pace-adjusted efficiency terms?

  • Each row shows GN, Game Type, Date, Gameflow, Team, Opponent, W/L, Score, Off PPP, Def PPP, Net, Off Shot, Def Shot, Off Poss, and Def Poss.

il.four_factors:
What This Tab Answers (Four Factors)

Show/Hide

Which four-factor components drove each single-game result? Each row shows one game with GN, date, teams, W/L, score, and the full PPP + eFG% + OREB% + TOV% + FTR breakdown for both offense and defense.

  • Scan eFG%, OREB%, TOV%, and FTR together to diagnose why a game was won or lost.
  • Compare offense and defense factor columns side by side -- a win can mask poor defense if offense was exceptional.
  • Look for patterns across games: consistent factor profiles suggest sustainability, while one-off spikes may be variance.
  • Cross-reference with the Summary view's 2PT/3PT frequency and accuracy splits to check whether a high eFG% game was driven by sustainable shot selection or a hot-hand streak.

Show/Hide Example
How to Read Four Factors (Real Example)

GN 17 (Bnei Herzliya vs Hapoel Galil Elion, 105-89) shows strong offense: PPP 128.0 with eFG% 63.3.

Defense was solid too: PPP allowed 107.2 with opponent eFG% 57.8 and FTR 50.8 (opponents got to the line frequently).

The split across eFG%, OREB%, TOV%, and FTR shows offense carried this win, despite allowing a high free-throw rate.

glossaryHtml:
Efficiency
  • PPP : Points per 100 possessions (points per possession x 100).
  • Net Rating : Offensive PPP minus Defensive PPP. Positive = outscoring opponents.
  • Possessions : Estimated offensive or defensive trips. More possessions = more reliable stats.
Four Factors
  • TS% : True Shooting -- scoring efficiency accounting for 2PT, 3PT, and free throws. Formula: pts / (2 x (FGA + FT trips)).
  • OREB% : Offensive rebound rate -- share of available misses grabbed. On defense, it measures opponent offensive rebounds allowed.
  • TOV% : Turnover rate -- turnovers per possession. Lower is better on offense; higher is better on defense.
  • FTR : Free throw rate -- FTA / FGA. Measures how often a team or player gets to the line relative to shot attempts.
Shot Splits
  • Off Shot / Def Shot : Each cell shows 2PT and 3PT frequency (how often that shot type is taken) and accuracy (FG%).
  • The blue bar is 2PT frequency, the orange bar is 3PT frequency.
  • Accuracy is shown as FG% text, colored from red (below league average) to green (above league average).
Colors & Ranking
  • Heat colors : Green = good, red = bad. Polarity flips for defense -- lower Def PPP is better, so green means fewer points allowed.
  • TOV% exception : On offense, lower TOV% is green (fewer turnovers). On defense, higher TOV% is green (more opponent turnovers).
  • Gray / no color : The player, lineup, or team has too few possessions to rank reliably (below the minimum threshold).
  • Percentile rank bars (Four Factors view): The slider shows where a player ranks from 0% to 100% among all players with enough possessions. 50% = league median. Only players above the minimum possession threshold are included in rankings.
Filters
  • Game Number (GN) : Each team's sequential game number in the season. Useful for filtering to a stretch of games.
  • Last N : Only include the most recent N games. Mutually exclusive with GN range.
  • Opponent Strength : Filter games by the opponent's league ranking over the selected sample.
  • Clutch (Tabs 2, 3): Limit to close-game possessions based on score margin, time remaining, and lead/trail status. Overtime qualifies by default.
  • Min Possessions : Minimum possessions to appear in the table. Higher = more stable data but fewer rows.

columnTooltips.Off: Offensive PPP diff: On-court minus Off-court
columnTooltips.Def: Defensive PPP diff: On-court minus Off-court
columnTooltips.Diff: Net PPP impact: On-court minus Off-court
columnTooltips.TS%: True Shooting: pts / (2 x (FGA + FT trips)). A trip is one visit to the line for a personal foul, credited to the lineup that drew it.
columnTooltips.USG%: Usage rate: share of team shot, free-throw, and turnover possessions while on court
columnTooltips.OREB%: Offense: offensive rebounds / available misses. Defense: opponent offensive rebounds allowed / available misses
columnTooltips.On Poss: On-court possessions for this player or split
columnTooltips.ON Poss: On-court possessions for this player or split
columnTooltips.OFF Poss: Off-court possessions for this player or split
columnTooltips.Poss: Number of possessions in this row or split
columnTooltips.Poss On Floor: Total possessions while this player was on the floor
columnTooltips.# Starters: Number of starters in this lineup
columnTooltips.GN: Team's sequential game number this season
columnTooltips.+/-: Point differential while lineup was on court

filterTooltips.min_poss_side: Minimum OFF + DEF possessions to appear in table
filterTooltips.min_on_poss: Minimum ON-court possessions for percentile ranking
filterTooltips.own_starters: Filter by number of starters in the team's lineup
filterTooltips.opp_starters: Filter by number of starters in the opposing lineup
filterTooltips.gn: Sequential game number within a team's season; player and team views both use the team's GN
filterTooltips.last_n: Only include the most recent N games in the selected team context
filterTooltips.opp_strength: Filter games by the opponent's league ranking over the selected sample
filterTooltips.clutch: Limit results to close-game situations based on margin, time remaining, and score status
filterTooltips.group_size: Number of players in each lineup combination (2-5)
filterTooltips.quick_preset: Apply a prebuilt compare split like starters vs bench, clutch vs non-clutch, or date/GN split
filterTooltips.players_on: Every player selected here has to be on the floor
filterTooltips.players_on_any: At least one player selected here has to be on the floor, on top of the box above. Leave it empty to match on the first box alone
filterTooltips.players_off: Skip any lineup containing a player selected here
filterTooltips.min_poss_lineup: Minimum total possessions required for the lineup, team, or compare side to appear

offOrebTooltip: Offensive rebound rate: offensive rebounds / available misses
defOrebTooltip: Opponent offensive rebound rate allowed: opponent offensive rebounds / available misses
